title: Hydrogen bonding
body: A hydrogen bond is an interaction between a hydrogen atom in a polar covalent bond and the negative end of another dipole. Water's polarity, which comes from its polar covalent hydrogen-oxygen bonds, produces hydrogen bonds between adjacent water molecules and contributes to hydrogen bonding between and within biological molecules.
ced_evidence: 1.1.A.1 "This polarity contributes to hydrogen bonding between and within biological molecules"; 1.1.A.2 "hydrogen bonds between adjacent polar water molecules"
